title:
Type to dispatch file requests
The file url should be url encoded to make sure all special characters in the "file url" are transported to the
server without any modifications. So, the following is how the request URL should be constructed:
AppUrl + "/file/" + Encoded file url. e.g
 ```js
 var appUrl = "https://myapp.c3.com"
 var fileUrl = "s3://myFileWhich I want to manipulate.txt";
 var requestUrl = appUrl + "/file/" + UrlEncoder.encode(fileUrl);
 requestUrl
 ```
The above-generated requestUrl should be used when communicating with the C3 app.

@see ApiUrl#file
